name: Brain V2 Local Baseline
purpose: Objective, reproducible measurement of Brain V2 as merged (PR #216, 001069c) before any Brain V3 workstream (W1-W11) changes production code. Every later phase's regression gates diff against this.

mac.role: code, unit tests, no-LLM cognitive benchmark, latency
mac.gpu: Apple M5 integrated (unused for this baseline)
mac.notes: F-001 (stale onnxruntime code signature killing cargo test with SIGKILL) fixed this session via `codesign --force --sign -`; local build artifact only, not a source change. No infra stack (Postgres/Qdrant/Neo4j) running during this run -- evals.cognitive falls back to SQLite/in-memory paths, which is what the suite is designed for (model-free, no network/DB server per its README).

home_gpu.role: heavy infra (pgvector, Qdrant, Neo4j, Redis, NATS), embeddings, GPU experiments, scale tests
home_gpu.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER, 8192 MiB VRAM
home_gpu.notes: Fast-forwarded from 001069c to b348c18 (docs-only diff) at the start of this run; no rebuild needed. Same run structure as the Mac, sequential rather than parallel to avoid resource contention on the weaker box.

config.ranker: hybrid: z(cos) + 1.5*BM25 + 0.2*z(ACT-R) over a 60-candidate pool (memory_ranking.py, memory_store.py:_search_memories_hybrid)

commands.memory_tune: PYTHONPATH=. python -m evals.cognitive memory --seeds tune --workers 8 --out results/memory_tune.json
commands.memory_heldout: PYTHONPATH=. python -m evals.cognitive memory --seeds heldout --workers 8 --out results/memory_heldout.json

mac.cargo_test: 179 passed (21 contracts + 10 stt-agent-contracts-parity + 70 stt-agent + 78 voice-agent), 0 failed
mac.barge_in_mutations: 38 mutations, 33 killed, 5 survived (all documented as equivalent: M12, N11, N12, N18, S5 -- same 5 as the pre-existing ADR-003 record, no regression)
mac.memory_obsolete_win_production: 0.61-0.99 across regimes on E3 (M-5 stale-fact-wins-retrieval confirmed quantitatively; W1 target is <=0.10)

affect_user_valence_to_mood_correlation.production_agent_mood_input: undefined (mood never moves off 0.00 under any script incl. hostile/positive -- correlation cannot even be computed)
affect_user_valence_to_mood_correlation.oracle_appraisal_input: +0.29 to +0.88 depending on script (what W2 should approach)
